blockers.summary: Canonical typed model, strict Lattice tokenizer/parser and deterministic compiler mappings are implemented for the normative grammar surface. Runtime-only context commands parse but intentionally fail canonical compilation; further work is validation/hardening rather than missing parser scaffolding.

Core semantic validation is implemented for identifiers, references, vocabulary, permission/profile contradictions, resource scope and evidence support; full RFC3339/BCP47 validation, delegation attenuation against authenticated parent authority and host execution-policy validation remain incomplete.
Permission-aware host authorization, runtime policy enforcement and replay/idempotency hooks are not implemented.

Positive/negative conformance vectors, canonical byte round trips and extended Lattice tests now exist; broader normative-vector coverage, fuzz/property coverage and cross-implementation fixtures remain incomplete.
Hostile-input, permission-escalation, evidence-provenance, Unicode/canonicalization and unresolved-context tests exist in part; systematic adversarial coverage remains incomplete.
No independent second implementation has passed the shared conformance vectors or reproduced canonical bytes.
Whitepaper publication revision, source figures and reproducible publication build are incomplete.
SLAI adapter/launcher and pinned package/submodule integration are not implemented.
Final clean release audit, migration policy, compatibility evidence and pre-training freeze are incomplete.
